text: An elephant's trunk joins its nose and upper lip into a flexible muscular organ. It can manipulate food, draw in water, explore by touch, and carry odors to the nose.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, Asian elephant fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/asian-elephant. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: An Asian elephant has a single fingerlike projection at the tip of its trunk, useful for precise grasping.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, Asian elephant fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/asian-elephant. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: An elephant's molars are replaced from behind as worn teeth move forward. Tooth wear and replacement give clues to the animal's age.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, Asian elephant fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/asian-elephant. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A giant panda grips bamboo with a fleshy pad supported by an enlarged wrist bone, forming a grasping pseudo-thumb.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, giant panda fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/giant-panda. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: A giant panda's digestive tract retains features of its carnivorous ancestry. Inefficient extraction of nutrients from bamboo makes long feeding periods necessary.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, giant panda fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/giant-panda. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Iron in a beaver's tooth enamel contributes to its orange color and strengthens the outer surface. The incisors grow continuously and are worn down by use.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, beaver fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/beaver. Consulted 2026-10-13.

text: Kori bustards draw water by suction, using a distinct drinking mechanism among birds.
provenance: Original factual paraphrase. Source: Smithsonian National Zoo, kori bustard fact sheet; https://nationalzoo.si.edu/animals/kori-bustard. Consulted 2026-10-13.
